name: Russo-Ukrainian War
description: Full-scale Russian invasion of Ukraine that began in February 2022, following years of conflict in eastern Ukraine since 2014.

name: Israel–Hamas War (Gaza War)
description: Large-scale war between Israel and Hamas in Gaza following the October 7, 2023 attacks, involving extensive military operations and humanitarian crisis.

name: Sudan Civil War
description: Armed conflict between the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces, causing one of the world's largest displacement crises.

name: Myanmar Civil War
description: Nationwide armed resistance and civil war following the 2021 military coup against Myanmar's elected government.

name: Yemen Civil War
description: Multi-sided conflict involving the Yemeni government, Houthi rebels, and regional actors such as Saudi Arabia and Iran.

name: Syrian Civil War
description: Prolonged multi-sided civil war involving the Syrian government, rebel factions, Kurdish forces, and foreign actors.

name: Eastern DR Congo Conflict
description: Renewed fighting between Congolese forces and multiple armed groups including M23 rebels in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo.

name: Sahel Insurgency
description: Ongoing jihadist insurgencies across Mali, Burkina Faso, and Niger involving groups linked to ISIS and al-Qaeda.

name: Somalia Conflict
description: Ongoing conflict between the Somali government, allied forces, and the Islamist militant group Al-Shabaab.
